initial_packs.meaning: Corrected initial guide/card packs are frozen separately; final published guides are independently verified again by the fullbook verifier.

limitations: Two standalone ifosfamide journey PDFs retain a short third-page cancer-response card; all source text is retained and bounds pass.
Orange diamond marker numerals retain a minor inherited rotated appearance; all eight marker locations are distinct and callout text is complete. One scoped display probe produced no pixel change.
Original NCCP binary/source-table visual verification, independent clinical/pharmacy approval and browser acceptance remain separate pending gates.
QR targets are decoded from generated pixels; this is not verification of live deployed URLs or physical printing.
